narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a lifestyle vlog and recommendation guide for travelers or expats returning to Japan. The creator shares five personal 'must-do' activities when visiting Japan from Taiwan, focusing on hair styling, affordable chain dining (Hidakaya), solo KTV, medical checkups/beauty treatments, and cost-effective seafood lunches. The intent is to provide practical tips and relatable cultural comparisons (e.g., KTV song selections in Taiwan vs. Japan) to engage his audience and encourage interaction through the final question.
